colombia.title: Disidencias de Calarcá declaran “objetivo militar” a tres alcaldes de Antioquia y anuncian guerra contra el Estado
colombia.title_en: Calarcá dissidents declare three mayors in Antioquia “military targets” and announce war against the state

mundo.title: A Far-Right Win Puts New Pressure on Germany’s Leader
mundo.snippet: Chancellor Friedrich Merz was a drag on his conservative party in its disastrous loss to the far right in a state election. He has vowed better communication, but no policy changes.
mundo.title_en: A Far-Right Victory Puts New Pressure on Germany's Leader
